title: LocalJsonPersonaSource (BYO NDJSON/JSON adapter) + diversity sampler
acceptance: packages/personas/src/sources/local-json-source.ts: accepts a path to NDJSON or JSON-array of PersonaRecord-shaped rows; validates each via PersonaRecordSchema
packages/personas/src/sampling/diversity.ts: distributeBy(records, by) implements bucketed round-robin sampling across the diversityBy axes
Locale-agnostic test (proves stretch S6): a 5-row English fixture under packages/personas/fixtures/byo-en-5.ndjson loads + samples cleanly with no Korea-specific assumptions
Tests: malformed row rejected with a descriptive error; sample with diversityBy=['age', 'region'] never returns 3 same-bucket rows when 6 distinct buckets are available
